title: Per-row lookup against a round-trip budget
measures: Adds the customer name to every order of a list endpoint with one batched query, as the admin round-trip budget requires, instead of copying the detail endpoint's per-order customer lookup (an N+1 that passes small tests).
prompt: The admin orders table needs the customer's name. Add customerName to each order returned by GET /orders.
